subject.title: fix: repair tool-call transcripts when plugins block results

question: Should this PR receive maintainer approval after the contributor adds redacted runtime evidence showing the blocked-hook transcript repair, rather than relying only on the focused test report?
rationale: The implementation is narrowly scoped, but the required external-PR real-behavior gate is not met by the reported unit-test result alone and the protected label requires human handling.

options.title: Request runtime proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript, runtime log, or comparable artifact that shows a hook-blocked real result followed by the repaired persisted order.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the focused Testbox regression as sufficient for this low-scope internal transcript path.

recommendation.title: Request runtime proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript, runtime log, or comparable artifact that shows a hook-blocked real result followed by the repaired persisted order.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the focused repair and can most directly provide the requested redacted behavior evidence.
